name: Naomi Osaka
intro: Naomi Osaka was born in Japan and grew up in New York and Florida. She has won four Grand Slams, the biggest tournaments in tennis. Two of them were right here at the US Open!
story: Naomi's dad taught her and her big sister Mari on public courts. She was the first Asian player ever ranked number 1 in the world. She lit the Olympic flame at the Tokyo Games. In 2023 she became a mom to a girl named Shai. Then she came right back into the top 15.

funFacts.text: Her comfort show is the anime Naruto. Her favorite character is lazy but brilliant Shikamaru.
Her French bulldog is named Butta. Butta goes almost everywhere with her.
She once quoted the Pokémon theme song in an interview: to be the very best.
Her dad is from Haiti and her mom is from Japan.
She lit the Olympic flame at the Tokyo 2020 Olympics.
Her serve has been clocked at 124 miles per hour.

watchFor: Look for her special walk-on outfit, then listen for her booming serve.
